verdict.rationale: Riskified documents protection beyond checkout. A login API (Account Secure) returns allow/notify/challenge decisions on customer login attempts, which addresses account takeover. Policy Protect returns approve/review/decline recommendations on claim requests, which addresses policy abuse. Both sit in the same developer platform as order screening. Missing for 10: fake account creation (signup) scoring, promo/coupon abuse scoring, explicit evidence of unified case management across these surfaces, and independent corroboration.

support.subject: As a risk analyst, protection extends beyond checkout — account takeover, fake account creation, promo and policy abuse are scored and managed in the same system

citations.quote: API is triggered only for customer-initiated authentication requests, e.g., user tries to login to their account
For each login attempt, Riskified returns one of the following decisions: Allow ... Notify ... Challenge
For each claim request, Riskified can provide an approve, review, or decline recommendation based on the identity
